as_told.title: Attributes in angel hierarchies that match modern alien phenomena

plain: The ranks of angels described by Thomas Aquinas, the medieval Christian theologian, are said to match many modern encounters with what people now call non-human intelligence, beings that are neither human nor animal. Jesse Michels passes this on from a conversation between Karl Nell, a retired Army colonel, and Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion. In another episode he makes the point in his own voice, credits Iamblichus, an ancient Greek philosopher, as well, and gives "irradiated light" as one detail the old accounts share with today's sightings. If it holds, today's encounters would be part of something people have been describing for centuries.
